confirmation: user confirmed 2026-09-26: main budget 2 cards/day, duration threshold > 2 s
base_protocol: configs/sensor_failure_model_v1.json after the F1 leakage fix (LEAKAGE_AUDIT.md)
question: Will a registered loss of connection ('Неисправен', organizer: loss of connection with the device) or a technical value start on a candidate channel of the card within the horizon after the cutoff?
interpretation: registered technical event; not a confirmed breakdown; action = remote check, crew visit only after confirmation

connection_loss_gt2s.label: connection_loss
connection_loss_gt2s.episode_filter: duration > 2 s or open at data end
connection_loss_gt2s.why: durations cluster on even seconds (polling cycle about 2 s); 1-2 s = one missed poll, treated as noise
connection_loss_gt2s.equivalence: source timestamps have 1 s resolution, so > 2 s means >= 3 s

connection_loss_all.role: declared variant, evaluated with the selected configuration
connection_loss_all.label: connection_loss

connection_loss_1h.role: declared variant, evaluated with the selected configuration
connection_loss_1h.label: connection_loss

72h.issue: rolling list: every day new cards are added for object x type pairs without an open card, open cards are not displaced and are shown as continuation until their own 72 h window closes

variable_budget_policy: up to the main budget, a card is issued only if its calibrated risk estimate is >= a level chosen on calibration_and_threshold cards (max precision subject to recall >= persistence at the same budget); reported beside the fixed budget, final stage only

card_units.B: object_id x system_type, except 'Диспетчерский контроль' which stays object_id x sensor_type
card_units.choice: the product unit is chosen by action with the technologist, not by the metric; both are reported

fold_note: cutoffs whose horizon window crosses the fit/evaluate boundary are dropped from fit (embargo = horizon)
fit_rows: fold fit years, candidate rows with a known label: all positives plus negatives with sha256('sensor-failure-model-v1:' + channel_id + ':' + issued_at) mod 100 < 10, weighted 10 before Balanced weighting

selection.metric: mean over folds of card precision at the main budget (24h: top-2 per day; 72h: rolling list with max 6 open)
selection.constraint: mean over folds of event recall at the same budget >= persistence event recall - 0.02
selection.tie_break: if precision differs by < 0.005: higher mean card PR-AUC, then the simpler candidate (persistence < fewer features < shallower model)
selection.always_reported: precision and recall at budgets 1, 2, 3 (24h) and max open 3, 6 (72h), ceilings, persistence

candidates.reference: persistence: hours since the last candidate of the label (ascending), ties by episode starts in 30 days

feature_sets.F3_noproxy: F3 without columns matching ctx__*_other_channels (audit F2: object identity proxy)

mlflow.run_layout: one parent run per fit (target x horizon x fold x feature set x CatBoost config) with the model; child runs per card unit x aggregation x combination with fold metrics; persistence runs per fold

final.refit: selected candidate per target x horizon refitted on all development years
final.holdout: 2025-07-01..2026-07-01, evaluated once, labelled 'second use of the holdout' (first use: sensor-failure-model-v1)
final.success: week-block 95% lower bound of (selected - persistence) card precision at the main budget > 0 and event recall >= persistence - 0.02; otherwise persistence is demonstrated
final.tz_targets: precision 0.7 / recall 0.5 are reported beside the ceilings with justification

time_budget: about 2-3 hours of compute; if exceeded, CatBoost configs are cut symmetrically before the run and the cut is recorded here
